name: PRT Residual Overlay Offline Math Spec

definitions.W_ref: higher-quality reference weight tensor, such as Q4/Q5 or approved dequantized reference

residual_overlay_math.objective: Approximate W_ref x with W_hat x for representative activations under strict memory budget, not full tensor reconstruction.
hard_constraints: Residual overlay must remain smaller than the Q4 memory avoided by using Q2
Runtime layout must be backend/native aware

candidate_residual_formats.name: ternary_residual_planes
candidate_residual_formats.formula: R_hat = sum_i alpha_i * T_i, T_i in {-1,0,+1}

candidate_residual_formats.name: hybrid
candidate_residual_formats.formula: INT4 for high-sensitivity layers, INT2 for medium layers, ternary or none for low layers

primary_tests: cosine(W_ref x, W_hat x) > cosine(W_ref x, W_base x)
relative_L2(W_ref x, W_hat x) < relative_L2(W_ref x, W_base x)

inputs: W_ref tensor or extracted layer weights
W_base Q2 tensor or reconstructed Q2 base
steps: extract one small model layer first, not 30B
quantize/dequantize to create W_base at Q2
compress R into selected residual format
compare W_base vs W_ref and W_hat vs W_ref on matvecs
report storage and active resident bytes
pass only if parity improves meaningfully under budget
minimum_pass_criteria: sidecar bytes < bytes saved by Q2 vs Q4

memory_budget_model.formula: resident_total = base_model_resident + active_KV + active_residual_pages + runtime_buffers + OS_headroom
rules: No OS swap as valid tier
Active residual pages must be explicitly budgeted
Residual overlay cannot exceed the memory saved by using Q2 instead of Q4
If Q2 plus residuals approaches Q4 memory, the design fails
No sidecar larger than the tensor or tensor group it replaces

dense_30b_example.conclusion: Residual overlay must be sparse and selected; full-model residual recovery is not viable on a 16GB host.

failure_modes: Q2 base quality too degraded to recover
Offline parity improves but generation quality does not

recommended_next_phase.primary: Phase 28N - small-model offline residual overlay prototype design
recommended_next_phase.primary_reason: The math must be validated on small tensors before touching dense 30B/32B files.
recommended_next_phase.secondary: Phase 28N companion - memory budget calculator for Q2 + residual overlay
